zh: 移动端更新至 v1.1.0 (3)：首页头像、标题与快捷提问垂直居中对齐，并移除小标题下方重复的模型选择按钮。
聊天收发与 Markdown 中的单张图片自动按原图比例自适应缩放（超宽横幅、超长截图与小图标均完整展示且不越界），多图消息升级为可左右滑动切换的层叠卡片堆，点击直接打开大图浏览器。
en: Bump mobile apps to v1.1.0 (3): vertically center the Home hero avatar, title, and starter prompts, and remove the duplicate model selector beneath the slogan.

Add aesthetic proportion-aware scaling for single images (preventing wide-banner overflow and blurry upscaling) plus an interactive swipeable stacked card deck for multi-image messages with tap-to-zoom lightbox support.
